why: The heuristic's rung on the game as it now stands. search-40 was searched before ADR 0112 chose every spell at its slot, and before this week's content moved from 3ae51e9f to 6198d349: Carapace +7 for 2 rounds, Alpha Roar in place of Fortress, Overdrive, the Stormborn rebalance (Emberstorm, Ice Grip), the heals (Renewal Burst 12, Vital Surge 10), and Necrotic and Ethereal level 2 (Bonewall, Vital Echo, Whisper). The weights price a defense, a heal and a regeneration the way the old catalogue paid them, and the agent now prices a DamageBuff by the hits its holder lands, so the set the table seats as its heuristic may no longer be the best one-move player. This rung starts from search-40 and scores every candidate against Greedy and against search-40 itself on the benchmark seeds, so that a set cannot climb by learning one of the two, and the hold-out replays both against search-23, a third opponent none of them was searched on. 5 rounds of 12, seed 0, as #325. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-40 against Greedy and against search-23 on the unseen seeds the hold-out replays. A lookahead rung from lookahead-45 against Greedy and that set follows once it lands.
